subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

Cannot compare with
solution: The correct answer is: **Far inferior to**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"Cannot compare with"** refers to something that is not as good as or far inferior in quality, capability, or value when compared to another. (तुलना नहीं कर सकता / बहुत ही निम्न स्तर पर) • **Example:** The performance of their team cannot compare with the champions of last year. • **"Far inferior to"** signifies something being of much lower quality, status, or performance in comparison to something else. (काफी निम्न स्तर का) • **Example:** This new phone cannot compare with the premium model—it is far inferior in features and build quality. • Hence, the correct meaning of **'Cannot compare with'** is **'Far inferior to'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Far inferior to**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Equally capable** (समान रूप से सक्षम): Refers to being equally skilled or proficient as another. • **Example:** Both candidates are equally capable of handling the responsibilities of the job. • **Nearly identical** (लगभग समान): Means very similar or almost the same. • **Example:** The twins are nearly identical in appearance, but their personalities are different. • **Better in quality** (गुणवत्ता में बेहतर): Indicates something that is superior or of higher standard. • **Example:** This fabric is better in quality compared to the cheaper alternatives available. 36:T996, The correct answer is: **Dim**.
